messages:
joan (Finance): Invoice INV-2026-091 shows ~320 GPU-hours billed as overage, but customer has an active reserved commit. The usage lines on the invoice reference nodepool="sandbox-a" rather than the committed pool. Can someone confirm how the commit was applied and whether this is a metering/mapping issue? cc @aj (Acct Mgmt)

aj (Acct Mgmt): Customer flagged this this morning. They expected the reserved commit to cover their 'prod-reserved' pool across regions. Invoice has a mix: some usage hit 'prod-reserved-eu' and some to 'sandbox-a'. I pulled the invoice lines:
```
line, pool, gpu_hours, unit_price
1, prod-reserved-eu, 120, 3.50
2, sandbox-a, 320, 3.50
3, prod-reserved, 40, 3.50
```
Looks like 320 GPU-hours were charged as overage at the on-demand rate.

billing-bot: Automated note: Invoice INV-2026-091 generated 2026-03-02T08:14:22Z. Usage export batch id: ue-2026-03-02-07. Meter tag used: "nodepool". No manual overrides detected.

sahil (SRE): I saw a nodepool rename during the infra deploy on 2026-02-27 — we renamed the logical pool from `prod-reserved` -> `prod-reserved-eu` for region tagging. Metering relies on the `nodepool` tag; exporter bug means older metrics still carried the old pool name for some hosts. I can run a quick reconciliation against raw metrics and the billing export.

tess (Eng-Infrastructure): Query I recommend to validate:
```sql
SELECT sum(gpu_hours) as hours, nodepool FROM raw_usage
WHERE month='2026-02' GROUP BY nodepool
```
If the 320h are split between hosts that had the tag before rename, that explains sandbox attribution. We didn't intend sandbox-a to be outside commit scope.

joan (Finance): ETA on recon? Customer is asking for a correction or credit. We should decide whether to issue a provisional credit while engineering investigates.

aj (Acct Mgmt): We can offer a provisional credit to avoid escalation. Suggest provisional credit equal to the overage line ($3.50 * 320 = $1,120) pending final reconciliation. Need finance lead sign-off. Also want a short note to the customer explaining we're investigating a nodepool-tagging reconciliation.

mike (Head of Finance): Approve provisional credit up to $1,500 for this invoice. Please document the reason and tag as "provisional-credit: billing-mapping-error". Final adjustment once recon complete within 7 days.

sahil (SRE): Running recon now. Initial findings: ~310 of the 320 GPU-hours are from hosts that had an old tag snapshot in the exporter; 10h genuinely run in sandbox-a (test workloads). Root cause: exporter edge-case where tag delta applied after metrics batch window. Plan: backfill corrected nodepool tags for Feb and re-run usage export, then re-ingest billing pipeline. I expect corrected invoice lines in ~48 hours. Will attach the recon csv when done.

joan (Finance): Thanks — I'll notify the customer and apply the provisional credit note. Please paste the recon CSV here when ready so I can close the credit. cc @aj

aj (Acct Mgmt): I'll send the customer a short update: "We've applied a provisional credit while we correct a metering tag mismatch; final invoice will be issued after recon (ETA 48h)." :thumbsup:

sahil (SRE): Recon CSV (excerpt):
```
host,orig_nodepool,corrected_nodepool,gpu_hours
host-12,sandbox-a,prod-reserved-eu,120
host-18,sandbox-a,prod-reserved-eu,90
host-23,sandbox-a,prod-reserved-eu,100
host-45,sandbox-a,sandbox-a,10
```
Backfill job queued.

joan (Finance): Perfect. I'll post the provisional credit and reference the ticket (TKT-9983). Thanks everyone.

mike (Head of Finance): Good. Keep me posted if final recon changes the dollar exposure beyond the provisional cap.

aj (Acct Mgmt): Noted. I'll follow up with the customer once the corrected invoice publishes.

sahil (SRE): Will update this thread when backfill completes and reprocessed invoice is available.
